review.evidenceBoundary: Source-only policy review. No new image build, SBOM generation, vulnerability scan, native build, or release qualification was performed.

availabilityProof.qualificationLimit: OpenPGP signature verification was not performed because no gpgv, gpg, sq, debsig-verify, apt-get, or Debian archive keyring was available. This proves TLS transport and exact agreement with downloaded InRelease metadata; it is not apt-secure or image qualification.

renewedExceptions.removalThreshold: Remove each exception before expiry at the first supported Debian 13 fix or corrected applicability evidence.

deferred: Fresh SBOM generation and vulnerability scans
